jobs.occupation: Global Media Strategist, The Barn - Arla, Aarhus
jobs.description:
Are you the type who can't help dissecting brand campaigns when you come across them on your favourite digital platforms? Do you enjoy understanding why certain messages and creative ideas work better on some channels than others? And are you eager to turn that curiosity into effective media campaigns for brands like Lurpak, Castello and Arla?

Then come join us at Arla Foods' in-house agency, The Barn, as our new Global Media Strategist.

So, what's The Barn?

Our in-house agency – The Barn – was established in 2019 to help our global and local brands win in a world of increasing media complexity. Today, we have strong teams specialising in campaign development and media strategy.

We work across disciplines and are curious, data-driven and results-oriented. You'll be working alongside specialists within strategy, planning and media buying, as well as other nice colleagues in creative production, data analysis, technology and creative development.

You can read more about The Barn here.

How will you make an impact?

As our Global Media Strategist, you'll join the global media team at The Barn, helping shape how our brands connect with people through effective media and communications planning. You'll work on campaigns from the initial brief through strategy, planning, activation and evaluation, translating brand ambitions and audience insights into clear media recommendations.

We believe great media planning goes beyond choosing the right channels. It's about connecting the different ways people experience brands – from building awareness and emotional connections to engaging with products and influencing purchase decisions. And understanding how media, messaging and creative ideas can work together to create a more connected consumer experience.

You will work closely with brand teams, creatives, strategists and media specialists across The Barn to bring these experiences to life.

Furthermore, you'll:

• Develop connected media strategies: Translate brand objectives and audience insights into data-driven plans, connecting channels and touchpoints across brand, product and shopper experiences.

• Connect media and creative: Bring a communication planning mindset to our campaigns, helping guide how messages, creative ideas and formats can work most effectively across platforms.

• Collaborate and challenge: Work with brand managers, creatives, media buyers and other specialists to develop integrated campaigns from brief to execution, presenting recommendations to global brand teams and challenging conventional approaches when needed.

• Explore and inspire: Stay curious about the evolving media landscape, emerging platforms and new opportunities, helping our brands make better use of media.

• Measure and improve: Work with our media and data specialists to evaluate campaign performance, understand what works and turn learnings into better future recommendations.

What will make you successful?

As a person, we expect you to be, well, first of all nice. Secondly, curious, collaborative and comfortable challenging the usual ways of doing things.

You're equally a strategic thinker and a doer. Someone who enjoys getting into the details of media planning but can also step back and see how channels, messages and creative ideas work together to build stronger campaigns. And you're the kind of person who loves exploring what media can do and isn't afraid to bring new ideas to the table.

• Minimum 5 years of experience with media strategy and/or comms planning, preferably from a media agency, in-house agency, international brand or similar role.

• Understanding of holistic media and communications planning across brand, product and shopper touchpoints, including digital platforms and advertising ecosystems such as Meta, YouTube and TikTok, and how to adapt messaging and creative formats to audience behaviour.

• Ability to translate business objectives and audience insights into clear media recommendations and actionable plans, using data, campaign performance and media measurement to inform decisions.

• Experience collaborating with different stakeholders and presenting recommendations in a clear and engaging way.

• Experience with international campaigns, connected TV, programmatic media or digital out-of-home is a plus.

What do we offer you?

This is your shot at joining an agency with an entrepreneurial mindset. The Barn was established in 2019 and today has full in-house capabilities covering everything from media strategy, planning and buying to technology, creative strategy and on-site production.

Our clients are our colleagues. This means we partner up across disciplines and focus our energy on building the best communications and digital solutions for our wonderful range of global brands, such as Lurpak, Castello, Starbucks, Cocio and, obviously, Arla.

We are fiercely ambitious, international and have hired from global hubs like London, New York and Singapore. But unlike most agencies, we also offer a healthy and sustainable work/life balance and real flexible working.

Some say The Barn is one of the best places they've ever worked (and even if they had 100 million dollars, they would still work here). Must be the informal atmosphere. Or the people. Or both.

How can you join?

If this sounds like the opportunity you've been waiting for, we'd love to hear from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis and close the job opening once we've found the right candidate.

For additional information, please reach out to Mathias Kjær at matkb@arlafoods.com. He’s nice too and very helpful.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

• Contribute to detailed technical dialogue with clients and project stakeholders.

• Support project development from concept to detailed design.

• Contribute to innovative and sustainable data centre solutions.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**

The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

On top of that, you will have:

• Experience working with large-scale infrastructure or industrial facilities.

• Experience leading technical teams or complex engineering projects.

**Work location.

**

The role can be based in any of our offices across Scandinavia. This includes offices in:

Norway – Bergen, Trondheim, Stavanger, Oslo and Fredrikstad

Sweden – Stockholm, Gothenburg and Malmö

Denmark – Copenhagen, Kongens Lyngby, Vejle, Aarhus, Odense and Aalborg

We work in international and multidisciplinary teams, and many of our projects are delivered across offices and borders.

**Do you have more questions?

**

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Mette Gutte at mtgt@cowi.com. Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com and www.arkitema.com where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

**A place to work and so much more

**

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home. With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

**Before you apply

**

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so the role may close as soon as we find the right match.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

**

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc Scientist focused on In Silico Predictive Methods for Antibody Purification
jobs.description:
Join Servier Symphogen as a Postdoc Scientist to pioneer in silico predictive methods for antibody purification and implementation in established purification workflows.

This 18-month Postdoctoral Scientist appointment, which includes the possibility of extension represents a unique opportunity to gain experience in an established pharmaceutical setting. The cross-functional nature of the role serves as excellent preparation for future professional advancement in industry.

You will evaluate and establish in silico methods to guide antibody purification strategies based on protein sequences, refining these in silico procedures for integration into existing purification workflows to increase efficiency.

You will join the Purification team within Drug Substance Development at Servier Symphogen and work closely with colleagues from Drug Substance Development, as well as from Research and Analytical teams.

**Objective

**This project aims to develop a digital framework for guiding purification strategies for complex antibody formats, including bispecifics and other high-complexity modalities. It addresses the challenge of product-related impurities, such as mispaired species and aggregates, by limiting the number of trial-and-error experiments. By integrating in silico tool evaluation with wet-lab chromatographic datasets, the project aims to identify correlations to enable sequence-based purification modeling. Ultimately, this approach standardizes and accelerates current purification workflows, ensuring complex antibody formats reach patients with efficiency and consistently high quality.

Identification of external collaboration opportunities may be necessary to establish the most appropriate digital framework going forward. Some travelling activity can be expected to attend conferences and visiting of external collaborators.

**Areas of responsibility

**This position focuses on developing a digital framework to guide purification strategies for complex antibody formats by correlating sequences with purification experimental data. The scope includes:

• Evaluation and implementation of in silico tools to guide purification of complex antibody formats, including:

• Integrating purification data into a digital framework to correlate experimental outcomes with antibody sequence information

• Building and implementing models to guide purification of complex antibody formats

• Continuously validating and refining established models using experimental data from relevant purifications

• Performing purifications to resolve product and product-related impurities to generate data for model development and refinement

• Evaluation and interpretation of analytical results in collaboration with the analytical team

• Presentation of findings internally and, where appropriate, through scientific presentations and peer-reviewed publications

**Qualifications

**You hold a PhD in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Biochemistry, Bioinformatics, Protein Chemistry, or a related field. To excel in this position, you must bridge lab and computational work by integrating experimental chromatography data into digital frameworks.

Preferred qualifications

• Demonstrated experience in evaluating and applying in silico tools, mechanistic modeling, or machine learning algorithms to predict protein behaviour or guide optimization of bioprocesses.

• Ability to design and implement digital frameworks that correlate protein sequences with experimental outcomes

• Skills in managing large experimental datasets and using bioinformatics tools to identify sequence-to-performance correlations

• A creative, innovative, and strategic team-player with a proactive mindset and a good sense of humor, excelling in cross-functional collaboration

It is of advantage if you have

• Practical experience in using ÄKTA chromatography systems and UNICORN software

• Theoretical and practical understanding of the purification challenges unique to bispecific antibodies and other high-complexity formats, specifically regarding the management of mispaired species and aggregates

• Knowledge within advanced analytical techniques for characterization purposes (e.g., Mass Spectrometry, CE-SDS, RPC and SEC)

• Experience presenting scientific findings internally and externally in written and spoken English (e.g. conferences and publications)

**Working at Servier Symphogen

**At Servier Symphogen, you will be part of the digital transformation of a highly engaged organization dedicated to advancing antibody-based therapeutics to improve the lives of patients. You will work in a collaborative environment with a strong focus on scientific quality, teamwork, commitment and professional development. You will be offered a relevant benefit package.

**Domicile

For further information about the scientific content of the position, please contact:

Jesper Buchhave Poulsen, Principal Scientist, Purification, Drug Substance Development, CMC  Biologics, email jesper.buchhavepoulsen@servier.com

For questions concerning employment terms, please contact Senior HR manager, Pia Holm Olesen, +45 4526 5050.

Please visit Serviersymphogen.com for more information about our company.

If you are interested in applying for the position, please mark your application, CV and relevant documentation “Postdoctoral Scientist for Predictive Antibody Purification” and mail to:

jobs-dk2@servier.com no later than January 18, 2027.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Symphogen is a subsidiary of Servier and antibody center of excellence primarily focused on oncology and immune oncology. We have a highly efficient antibody discovery and research platform supported by comprehensive early development capabilities.

Our antibody platform delivers antibodies with unique functionalities providing best or first in class potential as combination or mono therapy. Our approach and capabilities are well suited for combination therapies at the core of future cancer treatment.

jobs.occupation: Clinical Professor of breast cancer therapy
jobs.description:
The Department of Clinical Medicine, Faculty of Health, Aarhus University, in collaboration with the Department of Oncology, Aarhus University Hospital, invites applications for a position as Clinical Professor of breast cancer therapy, commencing 1 September 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The position is a permanent, combined appointment at Aarhus University and Aarhus University Hospital. It includes 40% of working time for research and other university duties. The department guarantees that this share can be increased to at least 50% if the successful candidate secures external funding for the remaining 10%.

As a Clinical Professor at the Department of Clinical Medicine, you will be part of what is probably the largest health science research department in Denmark. Our clinical research covers all the medical specialties and takes place in close collaboration with the university hospital and the regional hospitals in the Central Denmark Region. We have approx. 30,000 square metres of modern research facilities for experimental surgery and medicine, animal facilities and also advanced scanners at our disposal. The department has overall responsibility for the Master's degree programs in medicine and in molecular medicine. At the department we are approx. 670 academic employees, 500 PhD students and 160 technical/administrative employees who are cooperating across disciplines. As a Clinical Professor, you will be working at Aarhus University Hospital or another hospital in the Central Denmark Region. You can read more about the department here and about the faculty here.

Your job responsibilities
As Clinical Professor of breast cancer therapy, you will have joint responsibility for the development of the department's research and teaching environment, and you will contribute to the implementation of the faculty's overall research strategy. You are expected to contribute – both independently and in collaboration with others – to the development of the department by leading research of high international quality and contributing to ensuring a high academic and didactic standard in teaching. Qua your excellent collaborative skills and a broad academic network, you contribute to the academic development at Aarhus University and to the university’s profile both nationally and internationally.

Your main tasks will consist of:

• Development pf high quality oncology research in the department
• Carry out the organization and implementation of local and national studies
• Establish national and local PhD projects
• Ensure a strong representation in relevant Danish Multidisciplinary Cancer Groups (DMCG’s) and Scientific Societies
• Contribute to maintaining and developing the department's international relations
• Research of high international quality, including publication in international journals
• Teaching, supervision and examination of Bachelor’s and Master's degree students
• Teaching and knowledge dissemination on an international level
• Contribute to the funding of your own research group with the help of external research funding
• Supervision of PhD students and contributing to assessment and committee work at Aarhus University.
• Dissemination of your research to the outside world
During your employment at Aarhus University, you will report to the Clinical Professor and Chair of Oncology.

Your competences 
You must be qualified to practice at consultant level, with documented specialist expertise and clinical experience equivalent to that of a senior hospital consultant.

You have an excellent track record on breast cancer therapy research, and you have established yourself as a prominent researcher. You possess solid research and teaching qualifications at a high international level. You have broad international cooperative partnerships and great experience of research partnerships with private and public-sector stakeholders. You have also a documented ability to attract significant competitive research funding from national and international funding bodies. You collaborate with a range of national and international breast cancer clinicians and physicists to ensure national and international accrual of patients into your clinical studies. 

As s person, you are a helpful and motivational leader who inspires other researchers and build trusting relationships with students, colleagues and partners. As a lecturer you communicate the newest and relevant knowledge in a committed, clear and comprehensible manner. As a supervisor you are competent, inspiring, supportive and responsible.

You are ready to take co-responsibility for the development of the department's research and education at the highest international level and for ensuring that we maintain a good work environment. You naturally involve yourself in interdisciplinary collaboration at departmental, faculty and university level as well as nationally and internationally.

As a Clinical Professor you are expected to inspire and raise the academic level in the clinic, and are expected to help elevate clinical tasks to a high level.

We expect you to be fluent in oral and written English. International applicants are expected to learn Danish, and Aarhus University arranges Danish teaching.

In order to be assessed as qualified for a Professor position, you must meet these academic criteria.

Questions about the position
If you have any questions about the position, please contact Clinical Professor and Chair of Oncology, Signe Borgquist tel.: (+45 2262 4525).

Your place of work will be the Department of Oncology, Palle Juul-Jensen Boulevard 99, 8200 Aarhus N, Denmark.

Terms of employment
• In making the appointment, emphasis will be placed on a high degree of original production at an internal level and experience from teaching at different levels as well as contributions to the development of teaching activities and teaching material, hereby documenting that the applicant has developed the academic discipline from a research and teaching perspective.
• Moreover, there will be an assessment of the applicant’s ability to perform research and teaching management tasks.
• Further information on the appointment procedure can be found in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.
• The appointment is in accordance with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (Akademikerne).
• Remuneration is in accordance with the above, and the Salary agreement catalogue for staff at Health.
• Further information on qualification requirements and job description can be found in the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

Application
Your application must include the following:

• Motivated application
• Curriculum Vitae
• Diploma
• Template for applicant - professor
• A list of publications
• A teaching portfolio. We refer to Guideline on the use of teaching portfolios
• The ten publications stated as the most important in the 'Template for applicant - professor' must be submitted
• Research plan, which is part of the 'Template to applicant - professor' can be uploaded separately (optional)
• Coauthor statement(s) can be uploaded (optional)
• References/recommendations can be uploaded separately in the e-recruitment system (optional)
We refer to the faculty’s Guidelines for applicants.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

 

International applicant?
Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

About Aarhus University

Aarhus University is an academically diverse and research-intensive university with a strong commitment to high-quality research and education and the development of society nationally and globally. The university offers an inspiring research and teaching environment for its 37,500 students, including PhD students, and has 9,000 employees (full-time equivalents) and an annual revenue of EUR 1.2 billion. Learn more at international.au.dk

We are looking for a highly motivated and dynamic postdoc for a 1 year and 6 months position to commence 1 March 2027 or after agreement.

The postdoc will be part of the Parasites, Immunology and Gut Health (PIGH) group in the Section for Parasitology and Pathology.

A list of the group’s publications can be found at:

https://scholar.google.dk/citations?hl=en&user=70v-4RoAAAAJ&view_op=list_works&sortby=pubdate

Information on the department can be found at: https://ivh.ku.dk 

Our group and research
The PIGH group is interested in how dietary components and the gut microbiota interact to regulate type-2 immunity at mucosal surfaces, which is critical for protection against helminth parasites but can also cause pathologies such as allergies when dysregulated. We apply small (rodent) and large (swine) animal models and in vitro cell culture techniques to explore host-pathogen-microbiome interactions and nutritional immunology. The group is a multidisciplinary team embedded within the Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, with close links to other sections working on diseases, food chemistry, natural product chemistry, and the gut microbiome. Our aims are to develop novel therapies to prevent infection and disease in animals and humans. The group is international in nature, and the daily working language is English.

Your job 

In this position, you will work on a project exploring interactions between helminths and the host gut microbiome. We are particularly interested in how diet-driven changes in the host gut microbiome impact the parasite infectivity and host resistance. The main role of the postdoc will be to carry out research involving dietary manipulations and experimental parasite infections in laboratory animals. This will be coupled with extensive microbiome analyses including both amplicon-based sequencing approaches and shotgun (metagenomic) approaches and associated bioinformatic analyses. Furthermore, the duties of the Postdoc will include supporting the overall research goals of the group and contributing to a positive and supportive group environment that emphasizes teamwork, curiosity and positivity.

research, including publication/academic dissemination duties

research-based teaching

sharing knowledge with society
